name: Kasahara Tomoya
source:
He used to work as a company employee, but was easily restructured about two years ago due to the company's downsizing.
    After a brief period of unemployment, he is now working as a part-time clerk with the help of Takahiro Yoshimi, a senior student from his college days.

    At first, he was only forced to do various small chores related to her work,
    However, as Yoshimi gets more and more bossy with him, he is getting a little fed up with the way he is being treated in his private life as well.
